operations.content: File structure: main.cpp (195 lines), user.cpp (13 lines with empty stubs for user_init/user_main/user_cleanup), user.h

main.cpp implements CustomHeapManager (10MB bump allocator) with global operator new/delete overrides. When g_custom_heap is set, all allocations go through custom heap; when nullptr, uses malloc/free

Critical issue found: CustomHeapManager::deallocate() does nothing (bump allocator never frees). Objects allocated via custom heap but deallocated after g_custom_heap=nullptr would call std::free on custom heap memory, causing crash

Program flow: Application::init() creates g_custom_heap (line 148-149), Application::run() uses STL containers/streams that may allocate, Application::~Application() calls shutdown() which destroys g_custom_heap and sets it to nullptr (line 175-179)
estimatePi() function (lines 124-139) uses std::mt19937 and std::uniform_real_distribution which may allocate memory. If allocated via custom heap but deallocated after shutdown, would cause mismatch

Step 2: Read source files. Identified likely root cause - allocation/deallocation mismatch. Objects allocated via custom heap when g_custom_heap is active, but may be deallocated after shutdown() sets g_custom_heap=nullptr, causing std::free() on custom heap memory. Need to compile and test to confirm, then fix in user.cpp
